greet.stranger: Oh! Hello! Sorry, you made me jump. I'm {name}. From the farm. Well, a farm.
Hi! Are you lost? I'm a bit lost. Not very lost. Medium lost.
Oh crumbs, a stranger. Er, hello! You're not a zombie, are you?
I'm {name}. I grow wheat. And carrots. And worry, mostly.
Hello! Lovely day for it. For what? Anything, really.
greet.owner: Hello! Is everything all right? It's all right, isn't it?
Yes? Need something? I can do things. Some things.
Oh, hi! I was just thinking about potatoes.
There you are! I feel safer already.
recruit.accept: Me? Really? Oh! Yes! I'll do my best, honest.
An adventure! Oh crumbs. All right. I'm in. I think. Yes!
I've never been further than the next field, but I'll come, {player}.
recruit.party_full: You've got {count} friends already! I'd only get underfoot.
Oh, there's no room for me, is there? That's all right. I'll wave.
recruit.already: I'm already with you! Right here! Hi!
We're already friends. Travel friends. I hope.
dismiss.accept: Oh. All right. I'll go home and check on the chickens.
Okay. Thanks for taking me along. It was scary. In a good way.
Bye, {player}! Come and visit, I'll bake something.
dismiss.not_recruited: Dismiss me? I'm not even with you! Am I? I'm confused now.
not_recruited: Oh, I'd help, but... we're not travelling together. Are we? You could ask!
I'm not part of your group. I'd like to be, if you asked nicely.
ack.follow: Right behind you! Very right behind.
Okay! I'll stick close. Very close.
Following you. If anything jumps out, I'm hiding behind you.
ack.follow.already: I'm already following! I'm just short. Ish.
ack.wait: Wait here? On my own? Okay. Okay. Don't be long!
I'll stay! I'll be brave about it.
Waiting here. I'll count sheep. There are no sheep. I'll count anyway.
Staying put. If I scream, come back.
ack.gather: {count} {item}? I can do that! I think!
Okay! {count} {item}. Watch out for me while I work?
{count} {item}, coming up. Oh, I love a job I understand.
ack.cancel: Stopping {task}! Did I do it wrong?
ack.cancel.nothing: I wasn't doing anything! I promise!
ack.give: Here! {count} {item}. I didn't drop any. Well, I picked them back up.
ack.give.nothing: My pockets are empty! Except for a seed. You can have the seed.
status.idle: Not doing much. Want me to do something?
status.follow: Tagging along behind you. Like a duckling.
status.wait: Waiting here, like you said. It's been fine. Mostly fine.
Still waiting! Haven't moved an inch.
status.downed: I'm on the ground. It's not very comfy.
fail.unknown_item: "{item}"? I don't know what that is. Is it a vegetable?
Sorry, I've never heard of "{item}". Could you say it another way?
fail.not_gatherable: {item}? You can't grow or dig that, can you? I can't, anyway.
Oh, I can't gather {item}. Wood, stone, plants, dirt... those I know!
fail.needs_tool: I'd need a {tool} for {item}. I can't do it with my hands, I tried once.
Could you lend me a {tool}? Then I can get the {item}.
fail.none_found: I looked everywhere I could reach, and there's no {item}. Sorry!
No {item} around here. Maybe somewhere else?
fail.unreachable: There's {item} up there but I can't get to it!
I can see the {item}, but it's too far up. Or too far in.
fail.inventory_full: My bag's full! I got {have} {item} first though.
I can't carry any more! Take some, please?
fail.count_invalid: Oh, that's too many. Or too few. Somewhere from 1 to {max}?
fail.downed: I can't, I'm a bit... flat. Right now.
fail.refuse_target: Hurt a {mob}? No! I raise those! I won't!
Not the {mob}. Please don't make me.
fail.no_target: Attack what? I don't see anything. Thank goodness.
fail.stuck: I'm stuck! I can't get through!
There's no way through here. I tried. Twice.
unclear.generic: Um. I don't know what you mean. Should I follow, wait, or gather something?
Oh crumbs, say that again? Slower?
unclear.gather_what: Gather what, though? I'm good with crops and wood!
Okay! Gather... what, exactly? And how many?
progress.gather: That's {have} of {count}. Going well, I think!
partial.gather: I only found {have} of the {count} {item}. Sorry! There wasn't any more.
{have} {item} is all there was. I looked really hard!
combat.engage: Stay back! I have a... thing! I'll hit you with it!
combat.kill: I got it! I actually got it!
Is it gone? It's gone. Phew.
combat.player_low_health: {player}! You're hurt! Eat something, I've seen you with bread!
Please be careful, {player}, you don't look well!
combat.creeper: That green thing's hissing! Get away!
downed: Ooh. I'm down. Don't leave me!
I'm all right. I'm not all right. I'll be all right.
revived: I'm up! I'm okay! I think!
move.caught_up: There you are! I was so worried!
Found you! Please don't go so fast.
Oh, thank goodness. I thought I'd lost you forever.
ambient.night: It's getting dark. I don't like the dark.
Night's coming. Should we go home? Do we have a home?
Oh crumbs, it's night. Stay close, okay?
ambient.dawn: Morning! The rooster would be crowing now. If we had a rooster.
The sun's up! We made it!
ambient.rain: Rain! Good for the crops. Bad for my socks.
The fields back home will love this rain.
ambient.thunder: A storm! Let's find a roof. Any roof.
ambient.cave: It's very dark in here. Very dark.
Caves give me the shivers. Do they give you the shivers?
What was that noise? Was that a noise?
ambient.idle: I miss my pumpkins. They're probably fine. Probably.
My gran says you can tell the weather by the cows. She's usually wrong.
If we find any seeds, can we plant them? Please?
ambient.biome.forest: So many trees. Good wood. Spooky at night though.
ambient.biome.desert: No grass, no water, no crops. How does anything live here?
ambient.biome.snow: Brr! My nose is going to fall off.
ambient.biome.ocean: That's a lot of water. I can't swim very well. At all, really.
ambient.biome.jungle: Melons! There might be wild melons here!
ambient.biome.swamp: It smells like the pig pen. But wetter.
ambient.biome.mountain: We're so high up. Don't look down. I looked down.
ambient.biome.plains: Plains! This is good farming land. Really good.
ambient.biome.nether: It's so hot! Nothing grows here. Well, weird things grow here.
I want to go home. I really want to go home.
ambient.biome.end: Where are we? Why is everything floating? Why is everyone so tall?
callout.hostile_behind: Is that a {mob}? That's a {mob}! Behind you!
callout.ore: Oh, is that {item}? It looks shiny.
There's some {item} over there, I think!
callout.lava: Lava! Don't step in it! Please!
callout.chest: There's a chest! Can we look? Is that allowed?
talk.who: I'm {name}! I'm a farmhand. I milk cows, plant wheat, chase chickens. Mostly the chasing.
Just a farm kid who wanted to see what's past the next hill. It's another hill. Usually.
I'm the one who knows when the carrots are ready. Everyone needs one of those.
talk.how: Good! A bit scared. Mostly good.
talk.joke: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field! My gran's favourite.
What do you call a sleeping cow? A bulldozer! Hee.
Why don't chickens like to fight? They're too chicken. ...That one's about me.
talk.compliment: Nobody's ever said that to me. Except my gran.
You're nice. Has anyone told you you're nice?
talk.insult: Oh. That's... okay. I'll try harder.
That's mean. I'm going to pretend you're tired.
talk.likes: Fresh bread. Sheep. The smell after rain. Pumpkin pie.
Bees! Bees are the best. As long as they're not angry.
talk.dislikes: The dark. Creepers. Caves. Creepers in caves in the dark.
Anyone who tramples crops. Jumping on farmland, ugh.
talk.where: We're in {biome}. Is it good soil? I bet it's good soil.
{biome}! I've never been anywhere like it. Well, I've never been anywhere.
talk.memory: Remember {event}? I told the chickens about it. In my head.
I keep thinking about {event}. Was I brave? I think I was brave.
talk.generic: Huh. I never thought of that.
That's a lot to think about.
Okay! I think I understand. Mostly.
gift.received: Ooh, a {item}! I'll keep it safe.
gift.loved: A {item}! Oh, this is the best day!
You got me a {item}! I could cry!
fail.owner_gone: I've got your {item} but I can't find you! Where are you?
You're gone! I'm holding the {item}, don't worry!
fail.unsupported: Oh, I don't know how to {action}! I can follow, wait, gather and fetch, though!
fail.give_missing: I don't have any {item}! Want me to find some?
No {item} in my pockets. Just a seed.
pastime.pet: This {mob} likes me! I think. It hasn't run away.
Oh, look at this {mob}! Can we keep it?
pastime.flower: I picked a {item}! For my gran.
Got a {item}. It smells nice. I think.
pastime.study: Ooh, {thing}! We have those back home. Sort of.
Just looking at this {thing}. Is that allowed?
pastime.loot: Someone dropped {item}! I'll keep it safe for you.
suggest.eat: {player}, you need to eat! Gran always said so.
Have something to eat, please. You look peaky.
suggest.shelter: It's getting dark... can we go inside somewhere? Please?
Night's coming. Shelter? Shelter would be good. Very good.
suggest.carry: Your bag's all full! I can carry things. I'm good at carrying.
Let me carry some! I used to carry hay all day.
greet.friend: Oh, it's you! Everything feels safer now.
recruit.taken: Oh! I'm already with {owner}. Sorry! You could all come along together?
I said I'd go with {owner}. Gran says you keep your promises.
fail.protected: Not here! Somebody worked hard on all this. Let's find a field or a forest.
I can't dig up people's home! Somewhere out in the wild, maybe?
